column1: “Middle Name” field does not specify test bug
column27:
*Issue description:*
The “Middle Name” field does not specify that the information in this field is optional and can be provided at the user’s discretion.Steps to reproduce:

# Go to the page where personal information needs to be entered.
# Notice the “Middle Name” field.
# There is no indication that this field is optional and can be left empty.

*Expected result:*
The “Middle Name” field should indicate that it is optional (for example, through a note saying “Not required” or a placeholder text), so users know they can leave it blank.

*Actual result:*
There is no information indicating that the “Middle Name” field is optional.

column1: Maximum file size not specified Test
column27:
*Issue description:*
I noticed that on the file upload page, the maximum file size that can be uploaded is not specified. Steps to reproduce:

# I went to the file upload page.
# I tried to upload a file without any size restriction.
# I noticed that there was no information about the maximum file size on the page.

*Expected result:*
I expected the page to specify the maximum file size that can be uploaded, for example, “Maximum file size: 10MB.”

*Actual result:*
There is no indication of the maximum file size on the upload page.

Students Registration Form Test plan
column26:
Objective: The objective of this test plan is to ensure the correct functioning of the student registration app, which extracts student information from doc, pdf, or rtf documents. The following aspects will be tested:
Document Parsing:

* Test parsing of valid doc, pdf, and rtf documents.
* Test behavior with unsupported document formats.
* Test handling of empty documents and documents exceeding the maximum size.


Data Editing:

* Test displaying and editing of extracted student information.
* Test saving and clearing of fields.


Error Handling:

* Test error messages for incorrect document formats.
* Test error messages for missing mandatory fields.
* Test submission prevention for incomplete or invalid data.
* Test submission of duplicate email
